name: Silvia Fuentes
source:
Contrary to the other female members, Silvia is the calm older sister. Her biggest fears are chilis and spicy food. What else to expect after getting a chili-candy! 

[From [url=https://cuaima.itch.io/christmas-in-space]Itch.io[/url]]
